name: Balancer
description: Balancer is a decentralized automated market maker (AMM) protocol built on Ethereum that represents a flexible building block for programmable liquidity.

methodology.UserFees: Trading fees paid by users, set per pool by the pool creator (0.0001% to 10%)
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on the counted swaps, at each pool's own swap fee
methodology.Revenue: Balancer V1 takes no protocol fee, so protocol revenue is zero
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Balancer V1 takes no protocol fee, so protocol revenue is zero
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All swap fees are distributed to pool liquidity providers
methodology.Volume: Value of swaps in Balancer V1 pools, counted on the side that is WETH, DAI, USDC, USDT, WBTC or BAL; swaps between two other tokens and wash trades are not counted

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on each trade

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on the counted swaps, at each pool's own swap fee

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To LPs: 100% of swap fees are distributed to pool liquidity providers

methodology.UserFees: Trading fees paid by users, ranging from 0.0001% to 10%
methodology.Fees: All trading fees collected (includes swap and yield fee)
methodology.Revenue: Balancer V2 protocol collects 50% swap fees as revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of revenue to Balancer DAO.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of revenue to veBAL holders (None after 2026-04-23)
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 50% from swap fees paid by traders are shared to pool LPs

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on each trade (0.0001% to 10%).
Fees.Flashloan Fees: Fees paid by borrowers on Balancer V2 flash loans.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: 50% of collected fees taken as protocol revenue.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Share of revenue kept by the Balancer DAO.

HoldersRevenue.Protocol Fees: Share of revenue distributed to veBAL holders (none after 2026-04-23).

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To LPs: 50% of collected fees distributed to pool liquidity providers.

methodology.UserFees: Fees earned from all the trades.
methodology.Fees: Fees earned from all the trades and yields.
methodology.Revenue: Revenue earned by the protocol and holders, which is 25% ( 50 % before 2026-04-23 ) of the trade fees and 10% of the yield capture.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue earned by the protocol, which is 25% ( 8.75% before 2026-04-23 ) of the trade fees and 10% of the yield capture.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Portion of protocol revenue distributed to token holders (e.g., veBAL/BAL) (82.5 % of revenue before 2026-04-23, 0 % of revenue after )
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Revenue earned by the supply side, which is 90% of the yield capture and 75% ( 50 % before 2026-04-23 ) of the fees.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users from all trades.
Fees.Assets Yields: Yields captured from all assets in liquidity pools.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users from all trades.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees: Protocol + holders share of swap fees (25%, 50% before 2026-04-23).
Revenue.Assets Yields: 10% of yield capture taken as protocol + holders revenue.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: Protocol treasury share of swap fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Assets Yields: Protocol treasury share of yield capture.

HoldersRevenue.Token Swap Fees: veBAL/BAL holders share of swap fees (0% after 2026-04-23).
HoldersRevenue.Assets Yields: veBAL/BAL holders share of yield capture (0% after 2026-04-23).

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: LP share of swap fees (75%, 50% before 2026-04-23).
SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: 90% of yield capture distributed to LPs.
